framework.name: Common Core ELA reading literature and informational text (K–5), Common Core literacy in history/social studies (RH, WHST, 6–12), the C3 history and civics indicators (6–8), the Illinois Learning Standards for Social Science 9–12, and the teaching-about-religion principles World Religions uses
framework.short: CCSS RL/RI/RH / C3 / IL SS 9–12 / Teaching About Religion
framework.note: The course reads a tradition's texts as literature and as historical sources in a public school, so it cites the reading standards for the band (RL, RI, RH, WHST), C3 history for 6–8, Illinois SS.H 9–12, and one of the six principles in "A Teacher's Guide to Religion in the Public Schools" (First Amendment Center) that the AAR 2010 Guidelines build on; alignment is the course author's judgment, not a certification or an endorsement by any of these bodies.

standards.text: Identify the main topic of an informational text and retell its key details.
Know and use text features, such as headings and a table of contents, to locate key facts.

standards.code: Teaching About Religion · academic not devotional
standards.text: Study religion as an academic subject that describes beliefs and practices without leading worship.
